title: 第3章 断骨重生决第4章 魅影身法
content_zh:
第3章断骨重生决
渭水河边，一道身影盘腿坐在地上，一动不动。
楚风眠如今已经修炼这断骨重生决，足足有着一个时辰的时间了，在这一个时辰中，楚风眠身躯之中的灵脉被打碎凝聚无数次。
一次次的打碎，一次次的凝聚，所承受的痛苦，足以让常人昏厥过去，无数汗水，已经将楚风眠身上的长衣都是浸湿。
只是楚风眠，却是从没有停止这个过程，因为楚风眠感觉得出，灵脉在每一次打碎凝聚之后，都是变的粗壮一些，他身上的力量，也在变大。
“给我破！”
楚风眠怒吼一声，一股气旋便是在楚风眠的身躯之中流淌，他身躯之中的堵塞的灵脉在气旋的流动之下，嘭的一下子被贯通，无数灵力在其中自游流动。
瞬息之间，一股灵力便是开始在楚风眠的身躯之中游荡，浑身上下，便是充满着用不完的力量。
这一股灵力的出现，令楚风眠的实力，比起刚刚要强上数倍不止。
“终于打通了一条灵脉，也算是有着修炼武道的资本了！”
楚风眠站起身，他的脸上露出几分欣喜之色。
不过，一条灵脉只是算是开始，一条灵脉的灵师，穷极一生的造诣，都极低。
修炼到淬骨境五重，六重，便是已经到极限，像是更高的锻体境，神海境，更是绝不可能。
想要修炼到真正的武道巅峰，资质决不可缺。
只是现在楚风眠有着断骨重生决，资质的问题，再也不用担心。
“已经过去一日世间了，也该回去了。”
楚风眠站起身，拍了拍身上的尘土。
林府，楚风眠是必须要回去的，如今既然楚剑白得到了这具身躯，他便是有理由，去完成楚风眠想完成的一切。
那便是当上林府之主。
林武城。

在这渭水河边，修筑起的一座城池，这林武城的名字，便是以其中林府所命名，自然看得出林府，在这林武城中，有着举足轻重的地位。
打通一条灵脉之后，楚风眠便是已经感觉到他的身躯，轻灵了许多，之前前往渭水河畔，楚风眠足足耗费了两个时辰的时间，不过这一次他回到林武城，只需要了半个时辰。
脚下速度快上了数倍。
“咦，这楚大管家竟然出门了？”
“他不是一直藏在林府中吗？今天怎么跑出来了？”
林武城中，不少武者都一眼认出了楚风眠，有些惊异的议论道，他们看向楚风眠的眼神，只有不屑，嘲笑。
楚风眠的存在，绝对是林武城中的一大笑话，林府外府的大管家，居然是一个半灵脉的废物。
这让林武城中的不少武者，都以欺负楚风眠为乐。
毕竟对他们，林府可是高高在上的存在，他们不少人都从林府哪里受到过不少怨气，如今可以来欺负一下林府的外府大管家发泄出来，他们自然一个个心中乐意。
楚风眠虽然名义上的林府外府的大管家，但是实际上外府弟子，从来没有一人来帮助过楚风眠，反而都是以一种看笑话的样子来看楚风眠出丑。
曾经楚风眠便是因此，不敢离开江府。
就在楚风眠快要走到林府大门的时候，一道身影，便是从旁边人群之中走了出来，一下子挡在了楚风眠的面前。
“你们看，是曹大海。”
“这家伙，前几日被林府外门的几名弟子教训了一顿，看来今天楚大管家可是要受罪了。”
在说到“楚大管家”
这四个字的时候，几乎每个人的声音之中都带有着几分嘲笑之意。
“让开。”
楚风眠抬起头，看见眼前挡在前方的壮汉，平静的开口道。
若是换做以前的楚风眠，只怕是根本不敢开口，只会受到一番欺辱之后，在绕道而行。
不过这一次的楚风眠，已经不是曾经的楚风眠了，他的身躯之中，可是曾经剑意第一人楚剑白的魂魄。

这一次，他绝不忍让。
content_en:
Chapter 3: Broken Bones and Rebirth
By the Weishui River, a figure sat cross-legged on the ground, motionless.
Chu Fengmian has now been practicing this bone-breaking rebirth art for a full hour. In this hour, the spiritual veins in Chu Fengmian's body were broken and condensed countless times.
The pain he endured after being shattered and condensed again and again was enough to make an ordinary person faint. Countless sweat had already soaked Chu Fengmian's long clothes.
But Chu Fengmian never stopped this process, because Chu Fengmian could feel that every time the spiritual veins were broken and condensed, they became stronger, and the power in his body also became stronger.
"Break it for me!"
Chu Fengmian roared, and a cyclone flowed through Chu Fengmian's body. The blocked spiritual veins in his body were suddenly penetrated by the flow of the cyclone, and countless spiritual powers flowed freely in it.
In an instant, a stream of spiritual power began to wander in Chu Fengmian's body, and his whole body was filled with inexhaustible power.
The emergence of this spiritual power made Chu Fengmian's strength several times stronger than before.
"I finally opened up a spiritual vein, and I have the capital to practice martial arts!"
Chu Fengmian stood up, a look of joy on his face.
However, a spiritual vein is only the beginning. A spiritual master with a spiritual vein will have extremely low attainments throughout his life.
Cultivating to the fifth and sixth levels of the Bone Tempering Realm has reached the limit, and higher levels such as the Body Forging Realm and the Divine Sea Realm are absolutely impossible.
If you want to practice to the true peak of martial arts, qualifications are absolutely indispensable.
But now that Chu Fengmian has the art of rebirth from broken bones, he no longer has to worry about qualifications.
"One day has passed in this world, and it's time to go back."
Chu Fengmian stood up and dusted himself off.
Lin Mansion, Chu Fengmian must go back. Now that Chu Jianbai has obtained this body, he has a reason to accomplish everything Chu Fengmian wants to accomplish.
That is to become the master of Lin Mansion.
Linwucheng.
A city was built on the bank of the Weishui River. Linwucheng was named after the Lin Mansion. Naturally, it can be seen that the Linmansion has a pivotal position in Linwucheng.
After opening a spiritual vein, Chu Fengmian felt that his body was much lighter. It took Chu Fengmian two hours to go to the Weishui River before, but this time he only needed half an hour to return to Linwucheng.
The speed of his feet increased several times.
"Hey, Butler Chu actually went out?"
"Hasn't he been hiding in the Lin Mansion? Why did he escape today?"
Many warriors in Linwu City recognized Chu Fengmian at a glance and commented with some surprise. They looked at Chu Fengmian with nothing but disdain and ridicule.
The existence of Chu Fengmian was definitely a big joke in Lin Wucheng. The chief steward of the Lin Mansion was actually a half-spiritual waste.
This made many warriors in Linwu City take pleasure in bullying Chu Fengmian.
After all, the Lin Mansion is a superior existence to them. Many of them have received a lot of grievances from the Lin Mansion. Now they can vent their anger by bullying the Lin Mansion's chief housekeeper. Naturally, they are all happy.
Although Chu Fengmian was nominally the housekeeper of the Lin Mansion, in fact, none of the disciples from the outer manor had ever come to help Chu Fengmian. Instead, they all watched Chu Fengmian make a fool of himself as a joke.
Chu Fengmian once did not dare to leave Jiang Mansion because of this.
Just when Chu Fengmian was about to reach the gate of Lin Mansion, a figure walked out from the crowd and stood in front of Chu Fengmian.
"Look, it's Cao Dahai."
"This guy was taught a lesson by several disciples from the outer sect of Lin Mansion a few days ago. It seems that Butler Chu is going to suffer today."
When talking about "Chu Butler"
these fourWhen writing, almost everyone's voice contained a hint of ridicule.
"Get out of the way."
Chu Fengmian raised his head, saw the strong man in front of him, and spoke calmly.
If it were the Chu Fengmian of the past, I'm afraid he wouldn't dare to speak at all, and would only take a detour after being insulted.
But this time, Chu Fengmian was no longer the Chu Fengmian of before. In his body was the soul of Chu Jianbai, the former leader in swordsmanship.
This time, he would not tolerate it.
